name: ConsentBase – Lightweight GDPR Cookie Compliance
author: PAPEPO

sections.description:
ConsentBase helps WordPress site owners show a consent banner, record choices in a local database table, and hold selected tracking scripts until the visitor accepts the matching category.

What this free plugin includes

  • Consent banner with Accept / Deny / Save controls
  • Local consent logs you can view and filter in wp-admin
  • Optional GA4, Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel, and Pinterest Tag fields
  • Script attribute controls so configured tags wait for consent
  • Design and content customisation for the banner

Important (not legal advice)

ConsentBase is a technical tool that can support a consent workflow. It does not guarantee legal compliance with GDPR, CCPA, or any other regulation. Your obligations depend on your full site stack, privacy policy, lawful bases, and jurisdiction. Seek qualified legal advice for your situation.

Optional extras such as CSV export and agency white-label are offered separately as ConsentBase Pro on papepo.uk. The free plugin remains fully usable without Pro.

Official website: https://papepo.uk

External services

This plugin can load third-party tracking scripts only after a visitor grants the relevant consent category (and only if you enter the IDs). The plugin does not send scan data to PAPEPO servers.

When configured and consented, the visitor’s browser may contact:

  • Google Analytics 4 — traffic statistics. Terms · Privacy
  • Meta (Facebook) Pixel — ads/measurement. Terms · Privacy
  • TikTok Pixel — ads/measurement. Terms · Privacy
  • Pinterest Tag — ads/measurement. Terms · Privacy

Admin screens may link to https://papepo.uk for documentation and the optional Pro product.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the consentbase folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Open ConsentBase in the admin menu to configure tracking IDs and banner text.
  4. Use Preview banner as visitor (or a private window) to verify behaviour.
sections.faq:
Does this make my site fully GDPR compliant?

No tool can promise that. ConsentBase helps you present choices and control selected scripts. Compliance depends on your overall setup and legal advice for your case.

Where are logs stored?

In a custom table in your own WordPress database. Logs are not sent to PAPEPO.

What about CSV export?

CSV export and some agency features are part of ConsentBase Pro on papepo.uk. The free plugin shows full basic logs in wp-admin.

How do I test as an administrator?

Use the Preview banner as visitor link on the settings page, or open the site in a private window while logged out.
